verdict.rationale: Isaac ships official, first-party SDKs. Isaac Sim's Python namespace packages install via pip or conda, with pre-built wheels and self-built .whl files, and support standalone scripts that control robots and environments. Developers can also build custom OpenUSD-based simulators, use the open-source Isaac Lab framework, and use Isaac ROS packages, with source on GitHub. Missing for 10: API-reference depth and versioning/stability guarantees are not evidenced, the SDKs are documented as Python-first with no other language bindings, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
